Name: Fibromyalgia Mod
Author: tobers
Description:
I created this mod to help show what it is like to live with Fibrymyalgia.
Fibromyalgia has many symptoms, but the main ones represented in this mod are chronic fatigue and widespread pain.

Changes:
Max energy reduced by 50
When using energy, there is a 5% chance that your farmer will have a [i]pain flare up[/i] and take 1-10 damage.
Everytime you use energy and your energy is below 100, there is a 5% chance that your farmer will have an energy crash, and energy will drop to 0 (notably this does not make the player 'exhausted', giving you some room to recover.)
When you sleep and you are not exhausted, you will wake up with 50-100% max energy.
When you sleep and you [i]are [/i]exhausted, there is a 50% chance the exhaustion will clear and you will wake up with 30-60% max energy; if it does not clear, you will wake up exhausted and with only 10-30% max energy.

If you would like to read more, please follow this link:
https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/fibromyalgia/
